scope: Proposition 9.7 of the manuscript “Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions” (preprints/Bounded-klt-complements-for-Fano-contractions-September-25-2026/Bounded-klt-complements-for-Fano-contractions-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 066 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d50937326c7cb115), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 52. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Each residual level has pi actual probes in some Vm, of degree and cost O(1/si), whose initials are in Ki and algebraically independent over Ki+1. Each torus axis has opposite angular probes in Vmj with initial weights ±djβj in the full initial field; their corresponding degree- mj sections have weights mjχ ± djβj. Here dj are bounded positive integers, mj ∈ nZ≥0, and degrees and costs are O(1 + Lj). The residual and positive torus initials together are algebraically independent, and their monomials give box lower bounds with widths max(1, Wj).
